lines.dealt: What will you do with the cards you're dealt?
lines.shuffled: Every deck has been shuffled. Every deck can be put back in order.
lines.choices: You didn't choose the deal. You chose every move after it.

lines.hidden: A shuffle doesn't take the order away. It hides it, so it can be found again.
lines.noticed: Somewhere in that game was a move you almost missed. What helped you see it?
lines.hands: Fifty-two cards, each one held for a moment. Let your hands rest.
lines.attention: Patience isn't waiting. It's paying attention while you wait.
lines.smallGood: A win is a small, good thing. Let it be small. Let it be good.
lines.forget: The cards don't remember the last game. You're allowed to forget it too.
lines.again: Starting again isn't starting over. You know more than you did.
lines.noHurry: Nothing here needs you to hurry.
